other_conditions: Farmers must not be currently cultivating spices
Farmers possessing a forest rights certificate are also eligible
The grant is payable only once to a farmer
The grant applies for a minimum area of 0.25 hectare and a maximum of 2.00 hectares per farmer
benefits_summary: Provides up to 50% subsidy on seed cost (capped at ₹10,000 per hectare) for seed spice crops, and up to 50% subsidy on planting material cost (capped at ₹50,000 per hectare) for garlic, turmeric, and ginger.
